parsed.title: ULTERIOR MOTIVE
parsed.body:
If you have 2 Objective Cards,
you may during your Turn:

Choose 1 of the Objective cards and remove
the other one from the game. Then, draw
cards according to the Objective choice track
and move the marker on that Track by 1.

You must choose this Objective.
Mission Task must not be Fulfilled.
confidentlyVisible: Upright white typography on a black upper panel
Blue-lit white astronaut icon above the title with “2+” beside it
Title appears in a dark metallic framed banner
Background art depicts a damaged, blood-spattered illuminated computer display in a dark industrial interior
